From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation & next steps - Qontract discovery

Hi Samir / Priya,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the detailed product tour. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you an accurate pricing band and procurement path: 

- Usage profile: you mentioned a pilot that could ramp to roughly 50M-200M generated tokens/month in Q3 if the POC goes well. Please confirm if that monthly token range sounds right.
- Unit economics target: you said the finance team is aiming for something in the ballpark of $/1M tokens rather than $/token. Can you share the target $/1M tokens range (ballpark is fine).
- Procurement thresholds: for procurement, is there a minimum spend or contracting review threshold (e.g., >$100k requires legal/procurement sign-off)? Also, what procurement timeline should we expect (30/60/90 days)?

Next steps from our side: Connor will size the model options and provide two baseline bands (hosted vs committed capacity) and I’ll prepare a mutual action plan once we have your budget band. I attached a small pricing template/worksheet to capture your expected volumes — feel free to populate and send back.

Attachments: qontract_pricing_sheet.xlsx (pricing template)

If you prefer, we can jump on a 20m follow-up to confirm those numbers. Are you available Wed 10–11am PT?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@qontract.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@qontract.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & next steps - Qontract discovery

Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the template. Quick answers below (happy to sync if you want more detail):

- Monthly tokens: pilot ~50M/mo, scale to 150–200M/mo over 6–9 months depending on model quality and latency.
- Target unit economics: finance is eyeballing around $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens for commercial pricing (they provided a target CPC equivalent and asked us to aim there).
- Procurement thresholds: anything >$150k annual commitment triggers procurement/legal review. Under that, our standard PO process is self-serve and much faster.
- Procurement timeline: expect 4–8 weeks for anything requiring legal review.

I've attached a simple usage estimate we pulled together (qontract_usage_estimate.csv). We can provide more granular sequence/turn-level counts if needed.

If you can show a pricing band for both hosted (no commit) and a 12-month committed discount tier, that would be ideal — finance wants to see the delta. Wed 10:30am PT works for a quick sync.

—Samir
Samir Khan | Head of AI Products
Qontract Inc.
samir.khan@qontract.com

Thanks — talk Wed.
